title: Deviload: The Desktop Powerhouse for All Your Media Downloads!
published: True
tags: ytdlp, mediadownloader, youtube, rust
---

## Quick Summary: 📝
Deviload is a clean, user-friendly desktop application for Windows, macOS, and Linux that simplifies downloading videos and audio from various online platforms. It leverages yt-dlp for robust downloading capabilities, offering features like playlist management, chapter splitting, GIF creation, and direct YouTube sign-in.

## Key Takeaways: 💡

* ✅ Deviload is a user-friendly desktop GUI for the powerful `yt-dlp` tool, simplifying media downloads.

* ✅ It supports downloading videos and audio from YouTube, YouTube Music, and many other sites with various format and quality options.

* ✅ Advanced features include playlist management, live stream recording with scheduling, and automatic downloads for new content from followed channels/artists.

* ✅ Built with Rust and Tauri 2, Deviload offers a fast, native, and cross-platform experience (Windows, macOS, Linux).

* ✅ It automates media organization, saving time and effort for content curators and casual users alike.


## Project Statistics: 📊
* ⭐ **Stars:** 39
* 🍴 **Forks:** 5
* ❗ **Open Issues:** 0


## Tech Stack: 💻
- ✅ JavaScript


Hey fellow developers and media enthusiasts! Are you tired of wrestling with command-line tools just to download your favorite videos or music? Do you wish there was a slick, easy-to-use desktop app that harnessed the incredible power of `yt-dlp` without all the fuss? Well, get ready to be excited, because I've stumbled upon a GitHub project that's an absolute game-changer: **Deviload**!

Imagine a world where downloading content from YouTube, YouTube Music, and literally hundreds of other sites is as simple as pasting a link. That's exactly what Deviload delivers. It's a beautifully crafted desktop application built with the performance-oriented Rust language and the modern, cross-platform Tauri 2 framework. This means you get a fast, native-feeling experience whether you're on Windows, macOS, or Linux.

What makes Deviload so cool? For starters, it's not just a basic downloader. You can grab videos in various qualities (1080p, 720p, 480p) and formats like MP4, MKV, or WebM, or extract audio as MP3, FLAC, or WAV. The best part? You just paste a link, and Deviload instantly gives you a preview with the title, duration, and available streams, letting you pick exactly what you want. No more guessing!

But it gets even better. Are you following a playlist? Deviload handles entire lists, specific ranges, or even lets you pick individual tracks. It can even split content by chapters and remove SponsorBlock segments automatically. For those who enjoy live streams, Deviload can record them from the moment you add the link, showing you the recorded time and size. You can stop recording anytime, set duration limits, and even schedule daily recordings of the same stream! And don't worry if your computer shuts down; it saves your progress.

One of my favorite features for content curators is the 'Watched channels and playlists' and 'Follow an artist' functionalities. Add a channel or playlist, and Deviload will automatically download new videos as they appear. For music lovers, you can follow an artist's YouTube or YouTube Music channel, and it will fetch all their albums, EPs, and singles from the 'Releases' tab, neatly organizing them into `Artist / Album` folders with track numbers and cover art. This level of automation and organization is truly next-level and saves a ton of manual effort.

In essence, Deviload takes the robust, versatile engine of `yt-dlp` and wraps it in an intuitive, user-friendly graphical interface. It's perfect for anyone who needs to reliably download and organize online media without diving into command-line arguments. It's fast, feature-rich, and incredibly convenient. If you've been looking for a powerful yet simple media downloader, you absolutely need to check out Deviload. It's a stellar example of what modern desktop applications can be!
